description: The company's issued invoices, newest first, filtered by issue date, series, buyer (CIF, e-mail or code; list_clients finds them by name), status ("unpaid", "paid", "cancelled") and e-Factura state. Each row: series and number, dates, currency, total with VAT as Oblio wrote it, whether it is cancelled, the buyer, the payments recorded against it, its e-Factura state and its PDF link. Drafts are never listed. Pass nextCursor back, with the same filters, for the next page; get_invoice reads one invoice.

client_cif.description: The buyer's CIF as it is saved in Oblio (list_clients shows it).

client_code.description: The buyer's code in Oblio's client list.

client_email.description: The buyer's e-mail as it is saved in Oblio.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page, with the same filters. Leave it out for the first page.

efactura.description: Only invoices in these e-Factura states: "not_sent", "processing" (in SPV, not yet answered), "sent", "errors" (not sent because of errors). Checked page by page after Oblio answers; scanned says how many were read.

issued_after.description: Start of the period, YYYY-MM-DD (Oblio's issuedAfter, its start date).

issued_before.description: End of the period, YYYY-MM-DD (Oblio's issuedBefore, its end date).

limit.description: Invoices read per page, at most 100.

order.description: By the order Oblio created the documents in. Default: newest first.

series_name.description: The invoice series, exactly as list_series shows it.

status.description: "unpaid" or "paid" (collected in Oblio), both without cancelled invoices, or "cancelled". Leave it out for all.

name: list_invoices
title: List issued invoices
